discussion.key_messages: - A mostly quiet weather pattern looks to persist as systems continue to move in from the west, then dip south after traversing the Sierra range. - Temperatures are expected to run near normal through mid-week, then warming to 5-10F above normal through the remainder of November. - A signal exists for a return to an active pattern starting December 1st, though many differences exist regarding trough placement which would significantly impact the forecast yielding great uncertainty.
